correctness.rationale: For finitely aligned higher-rank graphs the relative boundary-path groupoid is the appropriate ample amenable model, and the twisted relative algebras are nuclear UCT algebras. Bönicke's twist-homotopy theorem supplies K-theory isomorphisms for evaluation. In the bootstrap category, the mapping cone of a K-equivalence has zero K-theory and is KK-contractible, so the evaluation class is invertible in KK. The common vertex projection gives the stated vertex-class tracking.
